proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL CONCERNING AN INDEPENDENT BOARD CHAIRMAN
proposals.topic_summary: Requests Board adopt policy requiring the Chair of the Board to be an independent member of the Board, with limited exceptions.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote against the shareholder proposals based on the reasons set forth in the Company's statements in opposition

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL CONCERNING EXECUTIVE INCENTIVES AND STOCK BUYBACKS
proposals.topic_summary: Urges Board to require Compensation Committee approval, with written explanation, of senior executive sales of compensation shares during share buybacks.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL CONCERNING DRUG PRICING
proposals.proponent: The Province of Saint Joseph of the Capuchin Order
proposals.topic_summary: Urges Compensation Committee to report annually on whether drug pricing public-concern risks are integrated into senior executive incentive compensation.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
